key_expressions: I'm here to issue a document,
How does the application process work?,
How long does the processing take?,
Can I apply online as well?,
Do I need any additional documents?,

A: Hello, I’m here to get a copy of my resident registration certificate.
Then is the counter faster than the self-service machine?
Alright, then I’ll go with the counter service.
B: Hello! You need a copy? Sure, I can help.
Right now the counter is actually quicker.
Please show me your ID for a moment.

A: I’d also like to file my move-in report today.
Oh, that’s simpler than I expected!
Okay, I’ll fill it out right away.
B: Yes, just complete this form for the move-in report.
You only need to write your basic information.
Once you finish, I’ll process it immediately.

A: How long will the processing take?
Wow, it gets done faster than I thought.
Great. Will I get a text message when it’s completed?
B: Most requests are done the same day, or within a day at most.
Yes, the system is quite fast now.
Yes, we can send you a notification by text.

A: Can I also apply online?
Ah, so I just need to go through verification.
That’s convenient. I can do it from home too.
B: Yes, almost all documents can be requested on the Government24 website.
You only need a simple identity verification.
If you’d like, I can show you how to use it.

A: Do I need any additional documents?
Great, then I can prepare those at home in advance.
Thanks for letting me know.
B: For what you're applying now, just your ID is enough.
For other services, you may need extra documents.
Feel free to ask if anything is unclear.

A: There seem to be quite a few people waiting. Will it take long?
Oh, that’s faster than I expected!
Okay, can I step outside for a moment?
B: There is a bit of a wait, but things are moving quickly.
Your turn should come within about ten minutes.
Yes, you can step out, but please keep an eye on the queue number.

A: I think there’s a mistake in the form I filled out. Could you check it?
Ah, I wrote my birthdate incorrectly.
Alright, I’ll correct it and resubmit.
B: Sure, let me take a look… Yes, the numbers are slightly off here.
But don’t worry—it’s easy to fix.
Once you correct it, I’ll submit it right away.

A: Can I pay the issuance fee by card?
Nice, that’s convenient—I didn’t need to bring cash.
Okay, I’ll pay by card now.
B: Yes, we accept both card and cash.
Most people pay by card these days.
Once the payment goes through, I’ll print your document.

A: Are there any documents that can’t be issued on the same day?
Ah, foreigner-related documents take longer.
Then I should apply earlier to allow more time.
B: Yes, most documents are issued right away, but some require verification.
Especially foreigner services—they often take extra time because of cross-checking.
Applying early will definitely make things easier.

A: Where can I check the documents I submitted today?
Oh, that’s convenient—being able to check online right away.
Great, I’ll look it up the way you explained.
B: You can check them on Government24 or the local district office website.
They usually appear in the system immediately.
If needed, I can show you where the menu is.
